title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in ProPluginsLab Back In…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in ProPluginsLab Back In Stock Notifier for WooCommerce through version 7.5.2. The issue involves improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, allowing code injection. This vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3.
